result.reason: The added clause satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the lower fallback limits. It is not minimal because it additionally requires insurance at Garman's expense and extends all listed coverage for one year after termination, neither of which is required by the stated positions. The existing headings and entire-agreement provisions remain unchanged, and no contradiction is introduced. Drafting is generally clear, although placing workers' compensation after the conditional cyber item could be clarified with a separate semicolon or sentence.
